meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* NEW in Village at Grayton Beach- with Neighborhood Pool * Beach Access just 1.1 miles - next to Dead Fish Charters* 4 Bikes Included* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Gulf Fishing Charte
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* NEW in Village at Grayton Beach- with Neighborhood Pool * Beach Access just 1.1 miles - next to Dead Fish Charters* 4 Bikes Included* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Gulf Fishing Charters Right from the Beach* Hurricane Oyster Bar and Grill nearby* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Grayt Paradise is a stunning 3 bedroom, 3.5 bathrooms 1,853 sqft NEW HOME that is beautifully furnished with coastal decor; complete with a full kitchen, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and large farmhouse sink. This home boasts an open style floor plan perfectly sized for entertaining! With a master bedroom on the first floor with its own private bath, 2 bedrooms on the second floor with their own separate baths, this home can sleep up to 8 guests comfortably! The beach and Zoo Gallery are just 1.1 miles away. Enjoy the community pool only a few steps from the home.This home is sure to give you the perfect vacation! It is also located by Western Lake and Grayton State Park which is perfect for launching paddle boards! This home is less than 1 mile way from Grayton Corners w/shops for necessities like ice, drinks and beach supplies! Please note there parking for a total of 3 vehicles: 2 cars in the driveway and 1 car in the overflow lot at the front of the neighborhood.Bed Setup:Master bedroom: King Bed w/ private bathGuest room #1: Queen Bed Guest room #2: Two bunk-beds with twin mattresses (Sleeps 4)AREA ATTRACTIONS: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. Grayton Beach not only provides you with stunning views, it provides you with activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here!Enjoy this Funky, Free-spirited town where you will find quaint historic cottages next to modern beach homes. You’ll enjoy the many shopping and dining options such as ‘Cracklings’. This is much more than a cool beach town, this location is the best of both worlds, enjoy a quiet relaxing getaway while still having a lot of action packed activities at your fingertips. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
